title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Client Policy and Registry Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned client and operator policy plus registry metadata for the remaining RFC 9461 requirements.
planned_changes:
- Add client policy and immutable plan objects for selected DNS service binding endpoints.
- Add operator publication guidance for equivalent HTTPS RRs, AliasMode, and TargetName convention.
- Expose SVCB RR type, port key, and automatic mandatory-port metadata.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused client-policy tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
completion_notes: The RFC 9461 DNS SVCB mapping is now trace-owned across naming, scalar endpoint selection, client policy, operator guidance, and registry metadata.
